# Generated by open-cake-ir from flash-kmeans-assignment-full-explicit-sm100a-v1; DO NOT EDIT.
# schedule_sha256=8cc9f3072ad8b6fe26b19046923d782c952ded7358e339bc51aeb6ec77396ccc
import cutlass
import cutlass.cute as cute
import cutlass.pipeline as pipeline
import cutlass.utils as utils
import cutlass.utils.blackwell_helpers as sm100_utils
from cutlass.cute.nvgpu import cpasync, tcgen05
from cutlass.cute.runtime import from_dlpack


IO_DTYPE = cutlass.BFloat16
ACC_DTYPE = cutlass.Float32
MMA_INSTRUCTION_SHAPE = (128, 256, 16)
MMA_TILE = (128, 256, 64)
PIPELINE_STAGES = 2
THREADS_PER_CTA = 224
NUM_CENTROID_LOOP_TRIPS = 4
NUM_K_LOOP_TRIPS = 2
EPILOGUE_WARPS = (0, 1, 2, 3)
EPILOGUE_THREADS = 128
MMA_WARP = 4
TMA_WARP = 5
REDUCE_WARP = 6
TMEM_COLUMNS = 256


@cute.struct
class SharedStorage:
    tiles_ready_mbarriers: cute.struct.MemRange[cutlass.Int64, PIPELINE_STAGES * 2]
    accumulator_ready_mbarriers: cute.struct.MemRange[cutlass.Int64, 2]
    tmem_holding_buffer: cutlass.Int32


@cute.kernel
def _cake_flash_kmeans_assignment_full_kernel(
    tiled_mma: cute.TiledMma,
    load_tokens_atom: cute.CopyAtom,
    load_tokens_source: cute.Tensor,
    load_centroids_atom: cute.CopyAtom,
    load_centroids_source: cute.Tensor,
    centroid_sq: cute.Tensor,
    distance_scratch: cute.Tensor,
    assignments: cute.Tensor,
    load_tokens_smem_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
    load_centroids_smem_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
):
    thread_idx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
    warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx())

    smem = utils.SmemAllocator()
    storage = smem.allocate(SharedStorage)
    token_stage = smem.allocate_tensor(
        element_type=IO_DTYPE,
        layout=load_tokens_smem_layout.outer,
        byte_alignment=128,
        swizzle=load_tokens_smem_layout.inner,
    )
    centroid_stage = smem.allocate_tensor(
        element_type=IO_DTYPE,
        layout=load_centroids_smem_layout.outer,
        byte_alignment=128,
        swizzle=load_centroids_smem_layout.inner,
    )

    tiled_load_tokens = cute.local_tile(
        load_tokens_source, MMA_TILE, (0, None, None), proj=(1, None, 1)
    )
    tiled_load_centroids = cute.local_tile(
        load_centroids_source, MMA_TILE, (None, None, None), proj=(None, 1, 1)
    )
    tiled_distance_scratch = cute.local_tile(
        distance_scratch, MMA_TILE, (0, None, None), proj=(1, 1, None)
    )
    mma_slice = tiled_mma.get_slice(0)
    mma_load_tokens = mma_slice.partition_A(tiled_load_tokens)
    mma_load_centroids = mma_slice.partition_B(tiled_load_centroids)
    mma_distance_scratch = mma_slice.partition_C(tiled_distance_scratch)
    identity = cute.make_identity_tensor(MMA_TILE[:2])
    mma_identity = mma_slice.partition_C(identity)
    fragment_a = tiled_mma.make_fragment_A(token_stage)
    fragment_b = tiled_mma.make_fragment_B(centroid_stage)
    accumulator_template = tiled_mma.make_fragment_C(
        tiled_mma.partition_shape_C(MMA_TILE[:2])
    )

    tma_shared_load_tokens, tma_global_load_tokens = cute.nvgpu.cpasync.tma_partition(
        load_tokens_atom,
        0,
        cute.make_layout(1),
        cute.group_modes(token_stage, 0, 3),
        cute.group_modes(mma_load_tokens, 0, 3),
    )
    tma_shared_load_centroids, tma_global_load_centroids = cute.nvgpu.cpasync.tma_partition(
        load_centroids_atom,
        0,
        cute.make_layout(1),
        cute.group_modes(centroid_stage, 0, 3),
        cute.group_modes(mma_load_centroids, 0, 3),
    )

    tmem_sync = pipeline.NamedBarrier(
        barrier_id=1,
        num_threads=(len(EPILOGUE_WARPS) + 1) * 32,
    )
    tmem = utils.TmemAllocator(
        storage.tmem_holding_buffer,
        barrier_for_retrieve=tmem_sync,
        allocator_warp_id=EPILOGUE_WARPS[0],
    )

    transaction_bytes = cute.size_in_bytes(IO_DTYPE, cute.select(load_tokens_smem_layout, mode=[0, 1, 2])) + cute.size_in_bytes(IO_DTYPE, cute.select(load_centroids_smem_layout, mode=[0, 1, 2]))
    tiles_ready_producer, tiles_ready_consumer = pipeline.PipelineTmaUmma.create(
        barrier_storage=storage.tiles_ready_mbarriers.data_ptr(),
        num_stages=PIPELINE_STAGES,
        producer_group=pipeline.CooperativeGroup(pipeline.Agent.Thread),
        consumer_group=pipeline.CooperativeGroup(pipeline.Agent.Thread),
        tx_count=transaction_bytes,
    ).make_participants()
    accumulator_ready_producer, accumulator_ready_consumer = pipeline.PipelineUmmaAsync.create(
        barrier_storage=storage.accumulator_ready_mbarriers.data_ptr(),
        num_stages=1,
        producer_group=pipeline.CooperativeGroup(pipeline.Agent.Thread),
        consumer_group=pipeline.CooperativeGroup(
            pipeline.Agent.Thread, size=EPILOGUE_THREADS
        ),
    ).make_participants()

    if 0 <= warp_idx <= 3:
        tmem.allocate(TMEM_COLUMNS)
        tmem.wait_for_alloc()
        accumulator = cute.make_tensor(
            tmem.retrieve_ptr(ACC_DTYPE), accumulator_template.layout
        )
        for centroid_tile in cutlass.range(NUM_CENTROID_LOOP_TRIPS):
            # CAKE_OP:distance_epilogue
            accumulator_ready_consumer.wait_and_advance()
            epilogue_tiler = (128, 64)
            accumulator_tiles = cute.zipped_divide(accumulator, (epilogue_tiler,))
            coordinate_tiles = cute.zipped_divide(mma_identity, (epilogue_tiler,))
            source_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
                tcgen05.Ld32x32bOp(tcgen05.Repetition.x64), ACC_DTYPE
            )
            source_copy = tcgen05.make_tmem_copy(source_atom, accumulator_tiles[None, 0])
            thread_copy = source_copy.get_slice(thread_idx)
            tmem_source = thread_copy.partition_S(accumulator_tiles)
            coordinate_source = thread_copy.partition_D(coordinate_tiles)
            output_tile = mma_distance_scratch[(None, None, None, centroid_tile)]
            output_tiles = cute.zipped_divide(output_tile, (epilogue_tiler,))
            destination = thread_copy.partition_D(output_tiles)
            registers = cute.make_rmem_tensor(
                destination[None, None, 0].shape, ACC_DTYPE
            )
            base = centroid_tile * MMA_TILE[1]
            for subtile in cutlass.range(cute.size(tmem_source, mode=[2])):
                cute.copy(source_copy, tmem_source[None, None, subtile], registers)
                coordinates = coordinate_source[None, None, subtile]
                for value in range(cute.size(registers)):
                    column = base + coordinates[value][1]
                    registers[value] = centroid_sq[column] - 2.0 * registers[value]
                cute.autovec_copy(registers, destination[None, None, subtile])
            accumulator_ready_consumer.release()
        tmem.relinquish_alloc_permit()
        tmem.free(tmem.retrieve_ptr(ACC_DTYPE))
    elif warp_idx == MMA_WARP:
        tmem.wait_for_alloc()
        accumulator = cute.make_tensor(
            tmem.retrieve_ptr(ACC_DTYPE), accumulator_template.layout
        )
        for centroid_tile in cutlass.range(NUM_CENTROID_LOOP_TRIPS):
            accumulator_ready_empty = accumulator_ready_producer.acquire_and_advance()
            for k_tile in cutlass.range(NUM_K_LOOP_TRIPS):
                # CAKE_OP:dot_mma
                tiles_ready_full = tiles_ready_consumer.wait_and_advance()
                tiled_mma.set(tcgen05.Field.ACCUMULATE, k_tile != 0)
                stage = (None, None, None, tiles_ready_full.index)
                cute.gemm(
                    tiled_mma, accumulator, fragment_a[stage], fragment_b[stage], accumulator
                )
                tiles_ready_full.release()
            accumulator_ready_empty.commit()
        accumulator_ready_producer.tail()
    elif warp_idx == TMA_WARP:
        for centroid_tile in cutlass.range(NUM_CENTROID_LOOP_TRIPS):
            for k_tile in cutlass.range(NUM_K_LOOP_TRIPS):
                tiles_ready_empty = tiles_ready_producer.acquire_and_advance()
                # CAKE_OP:load_tokens
                cute.copy(
                    load_tokens_atom,
                    tma_global_load_tokens[(None, k_tile)],
                    tma_shared_load_tokens[(None, tiles_ready_empty.index)],
                    tma_bar_ptr=tiles_ready_empty.barrier,
                )
                # CAKE_OP:load_centroids
                cute.copy(
                    load_centroids_atom,
                    tma_global_load_centroids[(None, centroid_tile, k_tile)],
                    tma_shared_load_centroids[(None, tiles_ready_empty.index)],
                    tma_bar_ptr=tiles_ready_empty.barrier,
                )
        tiles_ready_producer.tail()
    # distance_ready: a CTA-wide rendezvous, outside the dispatch
    cute.arch.sync_threads()
    if warp_idx == REDUCE_WARP:
        # CAKE_OP:argmin
        lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
        for group in cutlass.range(4, unroll_full=True):
            row = lane + group * 32
            best_value = distance_scratch[row, 0]
            best_index = cutlass.Int32(0)
            for column in cutlass.range(1, 1024, 1, unroll=1):
                candidate = distance_scratch[row, column]
                if candidate < best_value:
                    best_value = candidate
                    best_index = column
            # CAKE_OP:store_assignment
            assignments[row] = best_index
    # CAKE_KERNEL_END


@cute.jit
def cake_flash_kmeans_assignment_full(tokens: cute.Tensor, centroids: cute.Tensor, centroid_sq: cute.Tensor, distance_scratch: cute.Tensor, assignments: cute.Tensor):
    operation = tcgen05.MmaF16BF16Op(
        IO_DTYPE,
        ACC_DTYPE,
        MMA_INSTRUCTION_SHAPE,
        tcgen05.CtaGroup.ONE,
        tcgen05.OperandSource.SMEM,
        tcgen05.OperandMajorMode.K,
        tcgen05.OperandMajorMode.K,
    )
    tiled_mma = cute.make_tiled_mma(operation)
    load_tokens_smem_layout = sm100_utils.make_smem_layout_a(
        tiled_mma, MMA_TILE, tokens.element_type, PIPELINE_STAGES
    )
    load_centroids_smem_layout = sm100_utils.make_smem_layout_b(
        tiled_mma, MMA_TILE, centroids.element_type, PIPELINE_STAGES
    )
    tma_operation = cute.nvgpu.cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileG2SOp(
        tcgen05.CtaGroup.ONE
    )
    load_tokens_atom, load_tokens_source = cute.nvgpu.make_tiled_tma_atom_A(
        tma_operation,
        tokens,
        cute.select(load_tokens_smem_layout, mode=[0, 1, 2]),
        MMA_TILE,
        tiled_mma,
    )
    load_centroids_atom, load_centroids_source = cute.nvgpu.make_tiled_tma_atom_B(
        tma_operation,
        centroids,
        cute.select(load_centroids_smem_layout, mode=[0, 1, 2]),
        MMA_TILE,
        tiled_mma,
    )
    _cake_flash_kmeans_assignment_full_kernel(
        tiled_mma,
        load_tokens_atom,
        load_tokens_source,
        load_centroids_atom,
        load_centroids_source,
        centroid_sq,
        distance_scratch,
        assignments,
        load_tokens_smem_layout,
        load_centroids_smem_layout,
    ).launch(grid=(1, 1, 1), block=(THREADS_PER_CTA, 1, 1))


def compile_and_bind(tokens, centroids, centroid_sq, distance_scratch, assignments):
    import torch

    if tuple(tokens.shape) != (128, 128):
        raise ValueError("tokens must have shape [128, 128]")
    if tokens.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
        raise TypeError("tokens must be bf16")
    if tuple(centroids.shape) != (1024, 128):
        raise ValueError("centroids must have shape [1024, 128]")
    if centroids.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
        raise TypeError("centroids must be bf16")
    if tuple(centroid_sq.shape) != (1024,):
        raise ValueError("centroid_sq must have shape [1024]")
    if centroid_sq.dtype != torch.float32:
        raise TypeError("centroid_sq must be fp32")
    if tuple(distance_scratch.shape) != (128, 1024):
        raise ValueError("distance_scratch must have shape [128, 1024]")
    if distance_scratch.dtype != torch.float32:
        raise TypeError("distance_scratch must be fp32")
    if tuple(assignments.shape) != (128,):
        raise ValueError("assignments must have shape [128]")
    if assignments.dtype != torch.int32:
        raise TypeError("assignments must be int32")
    tensors = (tokens, centroids, centroid_sq, distance_scratch, assignments,)
    if not all(tensor.is_cuda for tensor in tensors):
        raise ValueError("every tensor must be on CUDA")
    if not all(tensor.is_contiguous() for tensor in tensors):
        raise ValueError("every tensor must be contiguous")
    if any(tensor.device != tensors[0].device for tensor in tensors):
        raise ValueError("every tensor must share one device")

    tokens_cute = from_dlpack(
        tokens, assumed_align=32
    ).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=1).mark_compact_shape_dynamic(
        mode=1, divisibility=128
    )
    centroids_cute = from_dlpack(
        centroids, assumed_align=32
    ).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=1).mark_compact_shape_dynamic(
        mode=1, divisibility=128
    )
    centroid_sq_cute = from_dlpack(
        centroid_sq, assumed_align=16
    ).mark_layout_dynamic()
    distance_scratch_cute = from_dlpack(
        distance_scratch, assumed_align=32
    ).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=1).mark_compact_shape_dynamic(
        mode=1, divisibility=1024
    )
    assignments_cute = from_dlpack(
        assignments, assumed_align=16
    ).mark_layout_dynamic()
    compiled = cute.compile(
        cake_flash_kmeans_assignment_full,
        tokens_cute,
        centroids_cute,
        centroid_sq_cute,
        distance_scratch_cute,
        assignments_cute,
        options="--generate-line-info",
    )
    return compiled, (tokens_cute, centroids_cute, centroid_sq_cute, distance_scratch_cute, assignments_cute)


def launch_once(tokens, centroids, centroid_sq, distance_scratch, assignments):
    compiled, arguments = compile_and_bind(tokens, centroids, centroid_sq, distance_scratch, assignments)
    compiled(*arguments)
    return assignments
